lessons.title: First anchor letters
lessons.description: Start with four common shapes and learn how Thai letters sit on the baseline.

lessons.title: Breathy contrasts
lessons.description: Add related kh-series consonants and feel the difference between paired sounds.

lessons.title: Ch-group foundations
lessons.description: Build out the first big consonant family used in many beginner words.

lessons.title: Voiced and nasal forms
lessons.description: Learn the letters that often appear in names and daily vocabulary.

lessons.title: Rare historic forms
lessons.description: Keep moving through the official alphabet, even the letters you will read less often.

lessons.title: The t and th block
lessons.description: These shapes recur constantly, so get precise with them early.

lessons.title: N, B, P and friends
lessons.description: Useful high-frequency consonants for real words and family names.

lessons.title: F and Ph forms
lessons.description: Finish the bilabial block and get ready for whole-word practice.

lessons.title: Flow letters
lessons.description: These smooth shapes show up everywhere in reading and writing.

lessons.title: Sibilants and aspirates
lessons.description: Finish the consonant inventory with the final common symbol families.

lessons.title: Final consonants
lessons.description: Close out the official alphabet before moving into vowels and tones.

lessons.title: Basic vowel marks
lessons.description: Meet the most practical vowel symbols you need to start reading words.

lessons.title: Front vowels
lessons.description: Add the vowels that wrap around the consonant frame.

lessons.title: Tone marks
lessons.description: See and write the four tone marks before they appear in vocabulary.

lessons.title: Loved names and useful words
lessons.description: A tiny starter set of names and words to connect the alphabet to memory.
